name: dynamic-island
title: Dynamic Island
description: A black rounded island rests as a small pill with one short label and springs into wider and taller shapes on demand. Its text fades and blurs out as the pill resizes.
use: You want a compact status pill that can grow into a small panel without leaving the page.
avoid: It needs a context provider around it, and only fixed size presets exist rather than free content.
a11y: The island is a plain div with no role or live region, and the spring resize ignores reduced motion. (keyboard: partial, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A solid black rounded pill sits in the middle of a dark panel above a row of grey preset buttons. At rest it holds a single short white label, and it stretches into a long shallow pill holding the same centred text.
behaves: Choosing a preset springs the island to a new width and height, its corners and label settling with it. The previous text fades and blurs away while the new label scales in.
customise: The island's label goes in as children and its size is set through a context hook; each preset's width and radius sit in a lookup table in the source.
weight: light: A few motion divs with spring resizes; fully idle when the size is unchanged.
demo: Preset buttons labelled default, compact, medium and large beneath the island.
issues: The large preset runs past the panel edge and is clipped in frame 3.
polishWhy: Confident spring resize and clean clipped corners; fixed preset widths limit the content that fits.
